dimensions.assessment: Affects Indian Tribes, Tribal organizations, and residents in specific Indian Health Service areas and Arctic regions.
dimensions.evidence: To provide public health veterinary services to Indian Tribes and Tribal organizations for rabies prevention

dimensions.assessment: Provides targeted veterinary services, deployment of public health officers, and a feasibility study.
dimensions.evidence: may expend funds, directly or pursuant to the Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act... for public health veterinary services

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes the expenditure of funds for services and studies without specifying exact appropriation totals.
dimensions.evidence: may expend funds, directly or pursuant to the Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act... for public health veterinary services

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Indian Health Care Improvement Act and the Prepare for and Respond to Existing Viruses, Emerging New Threats, and Pandemics Act.
dimensions.evidence: Title II of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act is amended by inserting after section 223

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing biennial reporting and permanent statutory inclusion in frameworks, alongside a one-year study.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the... a biennial report on the use of funds

missing_information: Dollar amounts authorized or appropriated for the veterinary services and feasibility study.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes HHS/IHS to expend funds for public health veterinary services to prevent zoonotic diseases in specific service areas, deploy USPHS officers, include IHS in the One Health Framework, and direct USDA to conduct an Arctic rabies vaccine feasibility study.
